wayback._eras_note: Six site generations on northzone.com (CDX enumeration 2026-09-29, scratch/cdx-enum.json): 2001-2005 a framed W5 site (Norwegian landing page, /portfolio and per-company .W5Doc pages, logos named by GUID), 2005-2008 an ASP site (/web/folder.asp, press through Hugin), 2009-2011 /portfolio/active-investments and /portfolio/exits, 2012-2014 /investments and /investments/<id>, 2015-2019 WordPress /investments/<slug>/, 2020-2025 WordPress /portfolio/<slug>/, 2026 Webflow (read live through site_api). The archive eras are parsed by scratch/archive-listings.py into sources/wayback/parsed/<year>.json with capture_url per row; no era here is a wayback-pull.py parser, so this list stays empty and the parsed files are the record.

roster._note: The roster is the live team page (Investment group) unioned with the archived /team/<slug> pages 2009-2026 (partner-roster.py) and the 2012-2014 /people/<id> pages read by name (scratch/people-era.py); curated per person with a dated basis in sources/wayback/partner-roster.json.

site_api._note: northzone.com is Webflow (2026 rebuild). The portfolio list renders 100 cards per page (?d42057d9_page=1..2; Finsweet cmsload fills the rest client-side) and every company has a page listed in sitemap.xml with the firm's own fields: founders, status (Active / Acquired / IPO), a hidden stage word (Early / Growth), a Unicorn tag, category, location, Founded year, Partnered year and the Northzone team member. scratch/site-scrape.py reads both; raw pages in data/filings/northzone/site-raw (gitignored). The insights archive (689 posts) is the news surface.
